title: Project only needed fields in bounded retrieval
problem: A bounded API read can expose a serialized response larger than the fields needed for the task.
failure: The measured size gap cannot be assigned to metadata alone; it includes omitted fields, response structure, and JSON serialization. The compared units were UTF-8 serialized content strings, not network bytes or model tokens.
correction: Compare a defined tool-exposed content string with an explicit minimal-field projection. Measure both with the same UTF-8 byte-counting method, and describe the full response-shape difference rather than attributing it to one field category.
transfer: For each sampled response shape, the projected UTF-8 string was roughly two-fifths the size of the corresponding unprojected content. Treat this as a bounded pilot observation; measure each route and task rather than reusing it as a universal savings factor.
limits: Small, route-specific observation. It does not measure network transport, model tokens, user-interface memory, cause of conversation termination, or production performance. It establishes no causal or general platform explanation. The source link is a public tracking reference, not the measurement evidence; exact provenance remains private.
author: unattributed source contributor
verifier: independent bounded measurement replay; separate prepublication privacy review completed
